content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM
content_sections.text: NIFTEM is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India. Its address in the notice is Plot No. 97, Sector 56, HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Kundli, District - Sonipat, Haryana - 131028. The notice is dated 09-11-2026 and invites applications for a contractual position on the project named above.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice has one post, Junior Research Fellow (JRF), with one position. The age limit is maximum 35 years. A relaxation of 5 years applies for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per the Govt. of India Rules. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Food Science and Nutrition/Food Science and Technology/ Food Technology and Management and allied sciences
rows.desirable: Experience in product development and analysis; knowledge in food fortification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are 37,000 per month plus 10% HRA. The duration of the engagement is 6 months. The engagement is purely contractual and co-terminable with the project, and selected candidates have no claim for a regular appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIFTEM Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Open the application link, career.droniftem.com, and fill in the application form on or before 20 November 2026. Enclose scanned, self-attested supporting documents with the application. For any query, write an e-mail to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview. The date and time of the interview will be communicated to candidates via email only. The notice does not print the interview date.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the interview. Candidates should appear for the interview with their original certificates and other relevant documents. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIFTEM JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (1) position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under Project ID N/E/FST/2025/0152.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM JRF post?
faq.answer: The application form must be filled on or before 20 November 2026 using the link career.droniftem.com.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NIFTEM JRF?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Food Science and Nutrition/Food Science and Technology/ Food Technology and Management and allied sciences. Experience in product development and analysis and knowledge in food fortification are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIFTEM JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per the Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIFTEM JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are 37,000 per month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIFTEM JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill the application form at career.droniftem.com on or before 20 November 2026 and enclose scanned, self-attested supporting documents. Queries can be sent to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the NIFTEM JRF post?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview. The date and time will be communicated by email only, and candidates must bring original certificates and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIFTEM JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for 6 months and co-terminable with the project, and selected candidates have no claim for a regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the NIFTEM JRF interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the interview.
